prompt: Build a read-only n8n node for GitHub issues on the real GitHub REST API (https://api.github.com).
Find the API docs yourself: https://docs.github.com/en/rest or the OpenAPI description in the github/rest-api-description repository.
You have no token. Public repositories work without one, but GitHub allows only 60 requests per hour without a token, so test with few requests.
A grader checks these names exactly:
- Node name `githubIssueReader`, display name "GitHub Issue Reader".
- Credential name `githubIssueReaderApi` with one field `accessToken` (a password field) for a personal access token. The node must also work without a credential.

- Operation `issue.getAll` ("Get many issues"). Fields: `owner` (string, required), `repo` (string, required), `state` (one of `open`, `closed`, `all`; default `open`), `labels` (string, optional; comma-separated label names; an issue must have all of them), `returnAll` (boolean, default false), `limit` (number, default 50; used when `returnAll` is false).
Follow the `Link` response header for pagination. Do not fetch pages that you do not need.
Emit one item per entry exactly as the API returns it (the endpoint also returns pull requests; keep them).
- Operation `issue.get` ("Get an issue"). Fields: `owner`, `repo`, `issueNumber` (number). Emit the issue object exactly as the API returns it.
Work in the current directory. Dependencies are installed: do not install packages. Do not ask questions.
Stop when the node builds, passes the format checks, and works against the API.
